About finmid

finmid is a platform enabling software businesses to grow their revenue by embedding financial services in their product through a single integration. By productizing the complexity of financial services, finmid empowers companies to offer financial services where FinTech isn't the mission, but enables the mission. More about who we are and what we do here.

About the opportunity

As an Entrepreneur in Residence, you’ll take full ownership of a business-critical area at finmid and build it into something that scales with the company. You’ll be responsible for one of our key partner networks across Europe, deciding how it develops and making sure it performs. At the same time, you’ll work hand in hand with our Legal Counsel to bring a new part of our work in-house and build it from the ground up.

This role is for someone who likes to solve problems from first principles, wants real responsibility early in their career, and gets energy from building things that didn’t exist before. You’ll set the direction, make the calls, and see them through to execution.

You’ll work closely with leadership and get the room to build things your own way. The internship runs for 6 months full-time. For the right person, it is the first step toward a permanent role and, over time, a leadership role at finmid.

In this role, you will

  • Take full ownership of one of our key partner networks across Europe and set its direction.

  • Grow the network and hold it to a high standard of performance.

  • Partner with our Legal Counsel to build a new in-house capability from scratch.

  • Turn open questions into clear priorities and drive them from idea to execution.

  • Own the KPIs for your area and report on them to leadership.

What you need to be successful

  • Above all, we’re looking for drive and for people who can show what they’ve done so far.

  • You have strong analytical skills and can turn open questions into a concrete plan.

  • You have started or led something yourself, such as a startup, a student initiative, or a side project.

  • You have relevant experience from internships in fintech, financial services, consulting, or a similar field.

  • You are studying or have just finished your Bachelor’s, ideally at a top university.

  • You take ownership without waiting to be asked, and you are comfortable making decisions when not everything is clear.

  • You speak excellent English. German is a strong plus.

Internship timeline

  • Start date — As soon as possible

  • Duration — 6 months

Benefits

  • Real ownership of a business-critical area from day one

  • Full-time offers for high-performing interns

  • Access to WeWork offices worldwide

  • Regular team off-sites across the EU

  • 30 vacation days per year
